cryptography.android_signing_key: AndroidKeyStore TEE-or-StrongBox non-exportable P-256 ES256 IEEE-P1363
cryptography.ios_keys: Secure Enclave P-256 signing and key-agreement authorities with App Attest binding
cryptography.android_attestation: Play Integrity Standard requestHash bound to the server challenge
cryptography.ios_attestation: Apple App Attest attestation/assertion bound to the server challenge

state_requirements: The native operation id and both device keys are committed before the personal code is dispatched.
The server persists only a credential verifier and an envelope sealed to the wrapping key.

Recovery challenge proof is signed by the current active transport-signing key while the challenge request binds the fresh pending signing and wrapping JWKs; the enrollment-operation proof is signed by the fresh pending key.
Missing current v2 signing authority, including every legacy-only state, requires an explicit public replace flow and can never silently downgrade recovery into enrollment.
A prior active credential remains active until atomic confirmation of the staged credential.
Local replace uses wire flow enroll with fresh hardware keys and attestation, and restores the prior local state if the pending operation is cancelled.
Resume returns the exact envelope before confirmation and a secret-free terminal result afterward.
Ordinary authentication rejects pending credentials; confirm has a dedicated pending-credential verifier.
Lost-key cancellation requires a separate manager-authorized operation.
Authorized-session creation uses a durable non-secret operation UUID so response loss replays after process death.
The bearer session remains in native memory and neither it nor the device credential crosses the WebView bridge.
No exportable-key fallback is permitted below Android API 31.
Android and iOS must match the backend-owned manager-device-auth-v2-golden.json fixture exactly.
release_blockers: Backend and both native implementations must complete review, merge, deployment, and exact live identity verification.
Required CI must cover the final merged commits and compiled native runtime tests.
The production Play Integrity cloud project/policy and Apple App Attest environment must be independently initialized and verified.
The real production Manager signer and anti-rollback baseline are not initialized.
